brief:
Palestinian construction worker Wael Sheghnoubi has been unable to retrieve his son Nidal's body since the Israeli military killed him in May 2025, according to Al-Monitor. The continued detention of the remains has prevented the family from conducting a burial, leaving them unable to find closure or move forward with their grief.

Sheghnoubi described the absence of a funeral as a barrier to relief, suggesting that burial rites hold deep significance for families seeking to process loss. The case reflects a broader pattern affecting multiple Palestinian families awaiting the return of relatives' bodies held by Israeli authorities.

title: Palestinian families await return of sons' bodies from Israeli custody
